description:
Remove numeric exit-code assertions that re-prove projected rows from the `cli_query_graph` suite, keeping each test's own property and its error-class evidence.

## Background

The exit-code projection suite (`cli_issue/command_exit_code_projection_tests.rs`) binds each command-to-exit-code row in both invocation forms, and its wildcard rows (`*` with 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 and 11) bind every command. Outside it, a subprocess test asserts success or failure and the property it adds, such as a JSON verdict, an error envelope code, remediation text or empty stdout. It names a numeric exit code only for a command and code pair the projection has no row for. The sweep counts numeric `.code(N)`, single- and multi-line `status.code()` comparisons with `Some(...)` (literal, `ExitCode::X` or derived), symbolic `ExitCode::X.code()`, and helpers that take an expected code.

Exit-code assertion sites in `crates/jit/tests/cli_query_graph`: `check_links_tests.rs` (7), `dep_add_redundancy_cli_tests.rs` (7), `scope_validation_tests.rs` (4), `graph_json_tests.rs` (2), `label_query_json_tests.rs` (2).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No test in these files asserts a numeric exit code for a command and code pair the projection binds; each asserts success or failure instead.
- [hard] REQ-02: Where a numeric exit code was a test's only evidence of which error class its path takes, the test asserts that class another way, such as the `error.code` of the `--json` envelope, instead of bare failure.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each edited test keeps the other properties it asserted, and a test whose only assertion was a projected exit code with no class to preserve no longer exists.
title: cli_query_graph tests stop re-asserting projected exit codes
